g.text: Solid arrow: reference Dashed arrow: dependency Filled diamond: ownership Hollow triangle: interface
Analysis concepts, not Java class declarations. Match, Round and Turn map to GameEngine state.
CardOccurrence describes a deck occurrence; Java Card is a value without a unique physical ID.
Invariant: cards in hands + draw pile + discard pile = 108.
